name: Freelance transcriptionist (multi-language)
summary: Freelance transcription work for GoTranscript in English or many other languages, paid per audio minute after a quiz and audio-sample test.
whatYouDo: You pick transcription tasks on GoTranscript's platform and type what you hear following its guidelines. Work is offered in many languages, which can help bilingual people; pay varies by language demand, task difficulty, speed and accuracy.
appeal: GoTranscript's jobs page says it is short on transcribers and editors and hiring is open (company claim, as indexed)
Many languages supported, so French or another language may open extra work
watchOuts: Advertised 'up to $1.75 per minute' is a ceiling across languages; third-party guides cite much lower English rates (around $0.60 per audio minute, unverified)
Unpaid grammar/guidelines quiz and audio transcription sample
Impersonation risk: the company warns to apply only directly and use only your own account; never pay to apply
Canada not specifically confirmed on an official page
Independent contractor with no guaranteed volume

training.notes: Must learn GoTranscript's guidelines for the quiz and sample.

compensation.notes: Official jobs page advertises up to $1.75 per audio minute, varying by language demand, speed, accuracy and complexity; third-party guides cite about $0.60 per audio minute for English (unverified). Left blank because no official English-specific rate was found.

reliability.notes: Company states a shortage of transcribers; no independent data on task supply found in this pass.

applicationSteps: Choose your language on GoTranscript's transcription jobs page and complete the online application
Pass a short A/B-type quiz on the guidelines
Transcribe a short audio sample (a few minutes) using the style guide
If accepted, pick tasks and withdraw earnings via PayPal or Payoneer
fitsIf: You want flexible text-only work and especially if you can transcribe French or another in-demand language.
notFitIf: You need a clear, reliable hourly rate before investing time in an unpaid test.
